title.narrative: EU-UNICEF Public Finance Facility in South and Southeast Asia Phase II

description.narrative: Contract related to: EU-UNICEF Public Finance Facility in South and Southeast Asia Phase II - These Support Measures for Asia for the period 2022-2024 provide the European Commission the possibility to finance small-scale activities that are needed for the achievement of the objectives of the Neighbourhood, Development and International Cooperation Instrument (NDICI-Global Europe) in those regions (Middle East and Central Asia, South and East Asia) . This action is focusing on initiatives to assist member countries to strengthen institutional capacities and skills to design and implement sound economic policieis and Public Financial Management (PFM) systems: enhance strategic allocation of resources and efficient service delivery, increase budget transparency and promote sustainable inclusive green growth, ultimately leading to reduce poverty.
